intro: Hollow Records closed in 2004. It has been boarded up ever since. Your old flip phone buzzes. Press Q to flip it open.

travelLines.2004: The screen flickers... 2004. The shop is still open, just.
travelLines.present: Snap. The phone closes and the street is today again.

notHereLine: There's nothing to use here in this era.

actions.label: picked up Mira's dropped demo CD
actions.line: A scratched demo CD: 'MIRA - first songs'. Someone dropped it.

actions.label: played it at the shop's listening post
actions.line: You slip the CD in. The owner stops sweeping. 'Who IS this?'
actions.lockedLine: The listening post is free. You have nothing to play.

actions.label: pinned her gig flyer where everyone walks past
actions.line: The owner hands you a flyer for Mira's first gig. You pin it up.
actions.lockedLine: An empty noticeboard. Nothing worth pinning... yet.

changes.label: Hollow Records is open
changes.line: Mira's first record sold out in 2005. She bought the shop and kept it open.

ending: Something old, into something modern. Press Enter to play again.

news.brief: You write the front page of the local newspaper, today. Use only the facts given; do not invent new events or names. Reply with only a JSON object: {"headline": "<at most 12 words>", "article": "<2 or 3 sentences>"}.
news.unchangedFact: Hollow Records, the record shop on the corner, closed in 2004 and has been boarded up ever since.

default.headline: Corner Shop Still Boarded Up, Twenty Years On
default.article: Hollow Records closed its doors in 2004 and nobody has opened them since. Neighbours say the street has been quieter without the music.

shop_saved.headline: Hollow Records Celebrates Another Year of Vinyl
shop_saved.article: Singer Mira bought the corner shop with money from her 2005 debut, which began with a demo CD someone played at the listening post. The shop is still open, and the noticeboard outside is still covered in gig flyers.
